nav_decomposition_note: The two-factor Shapley decomposition is exact for each fold's compounded terminal benchmark-relative NAV difference. Universe and parameter-selection components sum to the observed retrospective-minus-PIT fold effect.
concentration_note: Aggregate concentration statistics are calculated from security-level contributions that reconcile exactly to the arithmetic daily net-return stream, not to compounded terminal NAV. Security-level rows are intentionally not redistributed.
licensing_note: Raw licensed Norgate data and security-level derived contribution files are excluded from the public package.
